title: Enchanted Bloom Sphere
description: A luminous transparent sphere filled with blooming pink and magenta camellia flowers and green leaves floats in the foreground. The background depicts a dark, mystical night landscape with jagged mountains under a purple twilight sky.
prompt: A large transparent glowing sphere containing a lush bouquet of pink, magenta and white camellia flowers with green and yellow leaves, floating in the foreground. Dark mystical mountains and purple twilight sky in the background, soft bioluminescent particles, dramatic lighting, painterly fantasy style.
